core_obligations: Open stratum: the set of points where the inertia is flat and locally of finite presentation is open, and over the corresponding open substack the stack is a gerbe by the inertia criterion (proof lines 6848-6862)

Induction on the complement: form the reduced induced closed substack on the complement of that open, which still satisfies the hypotheses because its inertia is a base change of the inertia of the ambient stack, and apply the statement again (proof lines 6863-6895)

Conclusion: since the stack is quasi-compact the descending sequence of closed complements terminates, producing for every point a locally closed stratum over which the stack is a gerbe (proof lines 6896-6906)
proof_roadmap: 先取惯性平坦且局部有限表现的最大开子栈 U（该条件开）；由惯性判据，X 在 U 上是 gerbe。
对补集取既约诱导闭子栈 Z；Z 的惯性是 I_X 的基变换 ⇒ Z 仍满足假设。
对 Z 递归；由准紧性该递降的闭集列终止 ⇒ 每点落在某个局部闭的层里，且在每层上是 gerbe。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every point of an algebraic stack lies in a locally closed stratum such that the stack restricted to that stratum is a gerbe over it (author lemma at source lines 6829-6846, label lemma-every-point-in-a-stratum). The proof (source lines 6848-6907) takes the largest open substack on which the inertia is flat and locally of finite presentation, forms the reduced induced closed substack on the complement, notes that the hypotheses persist because the inertia is a base change, and inducts until the quasi-compactness of the space forces termination (proof lines 6848-6906). The open-stratum step and the induction with its termination are the substance. H3.
